title: a launch with two fields puts a ## Fields block, sorted by name, between the brief text and the JITSO rules, and its launch event has a fields object
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, Pre-release fixes (the fields reach brief.md and the launch event)
intent: The fields given with `--field` reach the session and the log. The values are given in reverse name order: brief.md lists them sorted (`env` before `ticket_key`), one `- <key>: <value>` line each, after the brief text and before the rules, so the rules stay last. The launch event of `.jitso/launches.jsonl` has a `fields` object of key to value.
